messages:
Leah (CS): Quick capture from BrightMap demo - collecting asks and blockers.

Sam (CS): List them out and Ill add to account notes.

Leah (CS): Bullets:
- URGENT: per-route cost export (CSV with route, model, tokens, computed cost) - finance blocking renewal.
- HIGH: team prompt presets (saveable, team-scoped)
- LOW: ability to pin model version per-route for stability during tests
Bug: embeddings from Route X/Y returning near-duplicates; attached screenshot: https://files.redwood/brightmap/embed-err.png

Ivy (Solutions): For CSV, they want computed cost only, no provider rate lines, and a single sheet for FP&A. Any PHI? 

Leah (CS): No PHI. They need one spreadsheet that maps tokens to cost so finance can sign off.

Ravi (PM): Creating tickets and tagging renewal-risk. Priorities: P0 export, P1 presets, P2 pin. Need estimates + security review.

OpsBot: Ticket RF-3301 created for "BrightMap per-route cost export" by Ravi. https://tracker.redwood/RF-3301

Marco (Product): Sam/Leah please capture repro for embeddings issue; could be preprocess divergence.

Sam (CS): Will upload a small notebook + sample vectors and include trace id 0x9c4b.

Leah (CS): BrightMap asked for a temporary support-export of daily aggregates until product solution ships (buys ~3-5 weeks).

Ivy (Solutions): I'll mock a CSV schema that hides rate math and include security checklist. Posting mock by EOD.

Ravi (PM): Adding RF-3302 for "model pin toggle". Assign to Marco for scope.

OpsBot: Ticket RF-3302 created for "Model pin toggle (BrightMap)" by Ravi. https://tracker.redwood/RF-3302

Marco (Product): Targeting T-shirt estimate for RF-3301 by Thu COB. Sam, ping eng-ml if notebook shows model-serving issue.

Sam (CS): Will do and attach preprocessing diff.

Leah (CS): Scheduling follow-up with BrightMap Tue 10am PT; need rough estimate by then to keep renewal healthy.

Marco (Product): Noted - will update RF-3301 when we have an estimate.

Ivy (Solutions): Mock CSV posted: https://files.redwood/brightmap/csv-mock-01.csv

Leah (CS): Will post customer acceptance criteria after the call. Thanks team.
